### Finding movement start

###### Get displacement |> velocity |> acceleration

```{R}
hand_cols <- grep("hand_[xyz]", colnames(dt), value = TRUE)

# create cols for moment-to-moment positional shifts
dt[,
  # cols named delta_hand_[xyz]
  (paste0("delta_", hand_cols)) :=
    lapply(
      .SD,
      # get lagged difference
      \(col) col - shift(col, n = 1, type = "lag")
    ),
  .SDcols = hand_cols
]

# same, but 2nd order difference (velocity)
dt[,
  velocity := sqrt(rowSums(.SD^2)) / (1 / 120),
  .SDcols = paste0("delta_", hand_cols)
]

# take 3rd order diff (accel)
dt[, acceleration := velocity - shift(velocity, n = 1, type = "lag")]
```

###### Pull in RTs

Which hopefully should expedite finding movement start

```{R}
klibs_files <- list.files(here::here("data", "raw", "klibs"), full.names = TRUE)

read_remake_pid <- function(file) {
  # file name leads w/ P#; grep for #, drop any following text
  pid <- gsub(".2024.*", "", basename(file))
  tmp <- fread(file)
  tmp$participant <- gsub("p", "", pid)
  setnames(tmp, "participant", "participant_id")
  return(tmp)
}

klibs_data <- rbindlist(lapply(klibs_files, read_remake_pid))
klibs_data <- klibs_data[practicing == FALSE]

# NOTE: klibs data contains all files (including dev testing)
# subsequent operations easier if 'fake' participants are removed
klibs_data <- klibs_data[participant_id %in% unique(dt$participant_id)]
klibs_data[, participant_id := as.factor(participant_id)]
```
